component.name: Entra RDP
component.summary: Remote desktop for Entra ID joined Windows hosts

description.p: Entra RDP connects to Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) joined Windows machines using native web account sign-in — the Linux equivalent of the "Use a web account to sign in to the remote computer" option in the Windows Remote Desktop client.

FreeRDP builds differ in how, or whether, they can show an Entra sign-in window. Without one, sign-in degrades to printing a login URL that must be pasted into a browser and the result pasted back. Entra RDP probes the FreeRDP binary in use, reports which sign-in methods it offers, and steps around builds that can no longer start after an OS upgrade.

ul.li: Entra ID sign-in through the default browser or an embedded window
Named connection profiles for multiple hosts and tenants
Toggles for audio, microphone, clipboard, drive and printer redirection
Live command preview, so nothing is hidden behind the interface
Automatic detection of each FreeRDP binary's sign-in support

description.p: Support for FreeRDP 3.32 and newer, and for Fedora 45.

ul.li: Recognises FreeRDP's sign-in helpers, which replaced WITH_WEBVIEW in 3.32
Adds a choice of sign-in method when a build offers more than one
Optional on-screen toolbar in fullscreen, with minimize and close buttons
Detects builds that cannot start after an OS upgrade and switches to a working one
Uses the distribution's FreeRDP when it can sign in, instead of compiling
Installs independently of the Python version, so OS upgrades no longer break it

description.p: Azure Virtual Desktop workspace files, custom environment variables, and release builds by default on the RPM route.
